title: PluginManifest
description: Declares a plugin's rendering-layer metadata: widgets, actions, value kinds, and transform kinds. The encoder consumes the widget entries (type, kind, childMode, slots, introducedIn) identically to core widgets. Additional fields (props, triggers, params) are informational — used by devtools, validation, and SDK capability negotiation but never by the encoding hot path.

pluginId.description: Globally unique plugin identifier. Lowercase, underscores allowed, 3-64 chars.

homepage.description: URL to the plugin's homepage or documentation.

description.description: Short description shown in the plugin catalog.

minSdkVersion.description: Minimum Flutter SDK protocol version required (semver). If the app's SDK is older, enable shows a warning.

widgets.description: Widget types this plugin provides. Each entry matches the shape consumed by both the TS and Go encoders.

valueKinds.description: Custom Value kind identifiers this plugin introduces (e.g. 'geoLocation'). Reserved for future use.

actionKinds.description: Custom action types this plugin provides, optionally with goja server-side handlers.

transformKinds.description: Custom Transform kind identifiers this plugin introduces. Reserved for future use.

preview.description: How plugin widgets should render in the Flutter Web preview editor (Epic 38 Slice B). Two modes: 'declarative' — the plugin ships a TypeScript stub that composes only core Orca Gateway widgets, compiled at build time into a static ComponentNode[] artifact the stock preview editor already knows how to render (no rebuild of the preview editor needed); 'web_native' — the plugin ships real Dart code that runs in the preview, which requires a per-tenant preview editor build (Epic 38 Slice D); 'none' — no preview, every plugin widget falls through to the UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder card.

marketplace.description: Marketplace listing metadata (Epic 38 task 38.8 / 38.9). Required icons at three sizes plus at least one screenshot surface in the plugin catalog browse UI and on the per-plugin install page.

type.description: Wire type name. Must start with uppercase. Must not collide with core widget types (enforced at runtime, not schema level).

kind.description: Widget category — same enum as core widgets.

childMode.description: How the encoder handles children for this widget type.

slots.description: Named slot list for structure widgets. Must be non-empty when kind=structure, empty otherwise.

introducedIn.description: Plugin version (semver) that first shipped this widget.

removedIn.description: Plugin version (semver) that removed this widget. Encoder skips it when present.

frozen.description: If true, the prop shape is immutable across plugin versions.

isSupportedOnWeb.description: Whether this widget can render inside the Flutter Web preview editor (Epic 38 task 38.1). Defaults to true. Set to false for widgets that rely on platform views, native-only APIs, or other capabilities absent on web. When false, the SDK substitutes the widget with either a registered web stub (Epic 38 task 38.3) or the UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder primitive (Epic 38 task 38.2).

displayName.description: Human-readable widget name shown in the UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder card and in the dashboard missing-widgets screen. Defaults to the widget type string when absent.

iconName.description: Optional Material icon identifier shown inside the UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder card.

docsUrl.description: Optional documentation link surfaced from the UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder card and the marketplace listing.

props.description: Informational prop schema for devtools and validation. NOT consumed by the encoder.

triggers.description: Event trigger names this widget can fire (e.g. 'onTap', 'onCameraMove').

handler.description: JavaScript source for server-side execution in the goja sandbox. Optional — actions without a handler are client-only.

kind.description: Preview strategy. 'declarative' means the plugin ships a TypeScript file composed of core Orca Gateway widgets that `orca plugin build` compiles into a static JSON artifact; 'web_native' means the plugin ships real Dart that runs inside the preview editor and requires a per-composition preview build; 'none' explicitly opts out of preview rendering, leaving every plugin widget as an UnsupportedWidgetPlaceholder card.

stub.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of the TypeScript file declaring the declarative stub tree. Only consulted when kind='declarative'. Defaults to 'preview/stub.ts' when absent. The file must export a default map whose keys are widget type strings and whose values are Orca Gateway engine Widget instances.

compiledStub.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) where `orca plugin build` writes the compiled ComponentNode[] JSON. Only consulted when kind='declarative'. Defaults to 'preview/stub.compiled.json'. This file is committed into the plugin repo so installs don't require a build step.

entry.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of the Dart file that registers web-native component builders. Only consulted when kind='web_native'. The entry must export a registration function compatible with the preview build pipeline added in Epic 38 Slice D.

icons.description: All three icon sizes are required for a marketplace-eligible plugin. Every size is validated as a PNG with exact pixel dimensions by `orca plugin doctor`. SVGs and other formats are rejected — PNG only keeps validation dependency-free and predictable across renderers.

screenshots.description: At least one static PNG screenshot is required so the marketplace listing has something visual to show. Optional YouTube video links may be added per screenshot for richer demos.

tagline.description: Optional short tagline shown under the plugin name in the marketplace listing.

small.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of the 32x32 PNG icon.

medium.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of the 64x64 PNG icon.

large.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of the 128x128 PNG icon.

path.description: Path (relative to the plugin root) of a PNG screenshot. No dimension constraints — we let authors use whatever aspect ratio matches the widget being demoed.

caption.description: Optional caption shown below the screenshot in the marketplace listing.

youtubeUrl.description: Optional YouTube video link demonstrating the widget in action. The marketplace listing embeds this as a play button overlay on the screenshot.

type.description: JSON type of the prop value.

enum.description: Allowed string values (only meaningful when type=string).

items.description: Schema for array items (only meaningful when type=array).

properties.description: Nested prop schemas (only meaningful when type=object).
